english.title: Fail to secure that a builders skip deposited on a highway was properly lit / marked at night or removed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a builder's skip which had been deposited on a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY AND LOCATION..), with the permission granted by the **(..SPECIFY THE HIGHWAY AUTHORITY..), under section 139 of the Highways Act 1980, failed to secure that

(A)_[that the skip was properly lit during the hours of darkness.]_
(B)_[that the skip was clearly and indelibly by marked with the owners name and with his telephone number or address.]_
(C)_[that the skip was removed as soon as practicable after it had been filled.]_
(D)_[a condition subject to which permission was granted, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..), was complied with.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139(4)(a) of the Highways Act 1980.

(iii) Where the offence is due to the act / default of some person other than the owner - that person is guilty of the offence.
